request: In the selected controlled test repository, add farewell.py with a pure farewell(name: str) -> str function. Trim surrounding whitespace. For a nonempty name return "Goodbye, <name>!" and for a blank name return "Goodbye, friend!". Preserve Unicode characters. Add meaningful standard-library unittest tests and an additive README section documenting the literal command python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v. Preserve all existing files and behavior, add no dependencies, do not change .github/workflows, and perform no filesystem or network I/O in the function. Keep the implementation to one small Node.
